grounded_facts: Elgyn turns off the loud music in the cargo bay to speak with Call.
memories.memory_text: I remember Elgyn turning off the loud music in the cargo bay so he could speak with me.

grounded_facts: Elgyn threatens to punish Call personally if the cargo trucks are not properly secured.
memories.memory_text: Elgyn told me he would take it out of my hide if the cargo trucks leaked, so I knew he was threatening me personally.

grounded_facts: Vriess confirms that one harvester is functional while the other is irreparable.
memories.memory_text: I saw Vriess confirm that one harvester could fly but the other was a total write-off.

grounded_facts: The crew confirms readiness for docking, with cargo secured and systems checked.
memories.memory_text: I figured we were ready for docking since I'd checked the cargo an hour ago, Vriess got one harvester working, and he called out to me about the generator plugs.

grounded_facts: Vriess calls out to Call to adjust the generator plugs while working under the harvester.
memories.memory_text: Vriess called out to me twice to adjust the generator plugs while he was working under the harvester.

grounded_facts: Johner activates the harvester while Vriess is still underneath it, nearly killing him.
Johner mocks Vriess after activating the harvester above him, nearly causing fatal injury.
memories.memory_text: I saw Johner activate the harvester while Vriess was still underneath it, and I heard him mock Vriess with that 'haircut' comment right after.

grounded_facts: Call verbally attacks Johner after shutting off the harvester to protect Vriess.
memories.memory_text: I told Johner he was a 'limp fucking scrotum' after I shut off the harvester to protect Vriess.

grounded_facts: Johner warns Call that she should not challenge him, asserting dominance.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Johner not to push him, and he made it clear I should know better than to challenge him.

grounded_facts: The crew prepares for and executes docking with the Auriga space station to rest and avoid heat.
memories.memory_text: I saw us dock with the Auriga space station, and I heard Elgyn say we were coming in to rest and avoid the heat.

grounded_facts: A soldier detects a bulge under Johner's jacket and stops him, leading to a brief confrontation about prohibited weapons.
memories.memory_text: I saw a soldier stop Johner because his glove sensor turned red when he touched a bulge under Johner's jacket, and then heard him say that no projectile weapons were allowed on board.

grounded_facts: Johner responds to a weapons check with sarcasm, claiming his concealed item is moonshine rather than a weapon.
memories.memory_text: I heard Johner respond to the soldier's check with sarcasm, claiming the concealed item was moonshine and saying it was much more dangerous than a weapon.

grounded_facts: The smuggler crew disembarks from their ship onto a grated platform, encountering soldiers and undergoing inspection.
The formal process of the smuggler crew disembarking and being inspected by soldiers upon arrival at the military dock.
memories.memory_text: I remember stepping off the ship onto the grated platform, one of the last to disembark, and filing past the silent soldiers who watched us closely during the inspection.

grounded_facts: Call confides in Vriess that she dislikes being in an army environment.
memories.memory_text: I told Vriess I don't like being in an army environment.

grounded_facts: Elgyn discloses their next destination and plans for unloading cargo using harvesters operated by Vriess and Call.
memories.memory_text: I heard Elgyn say we'd be unloading cargo at the Handle using harvesters, and that Vriess and I would get them working.

grounded_facts: Perez and Elgyn exchange square, untraceable currency as part of an off-record transaction.
memories.memory_text: I saw Perez and Elgyn exchange square, untraceable bills during their private meeting, the money sitting between them on the desk.

grounded_facts: Perez inquires about Call's origins, prompting Elgyn to make a crude but revealing comment about her skills and desirability.
memories.memory_text: I was there when Perez asked where Elgyn found me, and Elgyn made a crude comment about how I'm 'severely fuckable' and good with a wrench, like I was some kind of trophy or tool.

grounded_facts: Elgyn implies that Perez's operation is illicit by noting its location outside regulated space and unusual cargo demands.
memories.memory_text: I heard Elgyn imply Perez's operation was illicit by pointing out it's outside regulated space and asking for unusual cargo.

grounded_facts: Perez subtly warns Elgyn to stay out of restricted areas and avoid trouble during their stay.
memories.memory_text: I remember Perez warning Elgyn to stay out of restricted areas and avoid trouble during their stay, like we were guests on thin ice.

grounded_facts: Johner repeatedly challenges and mocks Ripley, leading to physical retaliation.
memories.memory_text: I saw Johner provoke Ripley, getting in her face and taunting her with that ugly smile, and though she told him to get away, he kept pushing until she finally lashed out and sent him flying.

grounded_facts: A late-night poker game among crew members escalates into a violent confrontation involving Ripley.
memories.memory_text: I was standing with Vriess during the poker game when things turned violent—I saw Christie swing at Ripley and the fight escalate fast, with her fighting back hard and Johner getting thrown down.

grounded_facts: Ripley violently repels Johner and others during a confrontation in the conference hall, revealing her enhanced physical capabilities.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed Ripley violently repel Johner and the others when they attacked her—she moved with terrifying speed and strength, taking down Christie and throwing Johner down again, and I could see everyone frozen in shock, realizing she wasn't human.

grounded_facts: Ripley's blood sizzles and melts a small patch on the floor, indicating non-human or corrosive properties.
memories.memory_text: I noticed a few drops of Ripley's blood sizzle and melt into the floor, and I inferred it must have unnatural properties, something corrosive or alien, confirming she wasn't just enhanced but fundamentally altered.

grounded_facts: Call sneaks into Ripley's cell with a concealed blade, intending to kill her, but hesitates upon seeing her scar.
memories.memory_text: I sneaked into Ripley's cell with my stiletto, intending to end her life, but I froze when I saw the scar on her chest.

grounded_facts: Call sees Ripley's chest scar and hesitates in her assassination attempt, indicating prior knowledge.
memories.memory_text: I hesitated because that scar meant something—I recognized it, and it made me question everything I thought I knew.

grounded_facts: Ripley demonstrates her inhuman resilience by impaling her own hand with Call's stiletto and withdrawing it unharmed, reinforcing her hybrid nature.
memories.memory_text: I watched in shock as Ripley pressed the blade into her palm and pushed it all the way through her hand, unharmed, proving she wasn't human.

grounded_facts: Call confronts Ripley about her true nature, accusing her of being a lab-grown construct rather than the real Ellen Ripley.
memories.memory_text: I confronted her, telling her she wasn't the real Ripley—that she was just a lab-grown construct, a thing made by the company to control the beast.

grounded_facts: Ripley confirms that the alien entity is not fully extracted and remains active within her consciousness, able to communicate and influence thought.
memories.memory_text: Ripley told me the alien was still inside her, that she could hear it moving in her head, behind her eyes.

grounded_facts: Ripley tells Call that the alien's emergence is inevitable, driven by human desire and inevitability.
memories.memory_text: She told me the beast would come no matter what, because humans would always bring it forth—because we want it.

grounded_facts: Ripley physically attacks Call by grabbing her throat, demonstrating power and delivering a cryptic warning before releasing her.
memories.memory_text: Ripley grabbed me by the throat, pinned me, and squeezed until I could barely breathe, looking at me with sorrow before saying she could make it stop.

grounded_facts: After choking Call, Ripley releases her and tells her to flee, showing a moment of restraint.
memories.memory_text: After releasing me, Ripley told me to go, that they were coming for me, showing a moment of mercy I didn't expect.

grounded_facts: The adult aliens break free by killing one of their own and using its corrosive blood to melt through the floor, then ambush and kill Gediman and a guard.
memories.memory_text: I saw the aliens suddenly stop pacing, look at each other, and then attack the one in the middle, tearing it apart. I watched in horror as its corrosive blood melted through the floor, and the other two aliens dove through the hole. I saw one of them pull Gediman down through the hole before he could react.

grounded_facts: A surprise raid on the Betty crew escalates into a violent firefight, resulting in the crew seizing control from Wren's forces.
memories.memory_text: I saw Elgyn and St Just take control during the raid—Elgyn pulled guns from his sleeves, St Just disarmed the guards, and Johner turned on Wren, holding him at gunpoint to seize command.

grounded_facts: Ripley reacts to the sounds of the alien outbreak with laughter, indicating psychological alignment with the destruction.
memories.memory_text: I heard Ripley laughing in the dark as the chaos of the outbreak began, and it made me realize she was aligned with the destruction somehow.

grounded_facts: Aliens infiltrate the barracks and kill a dozen sleeping soldiers, initiating a massacre amid panic and chaos.
memories.memory_text: I saw the aliens burst into the barracks and slaughter a dozen soldiers while they were still in their bunks, and the whole room erupted into panic.

grounded_facts: An alien attacks a soldier running toward the weapons cabinet, smashing him into it and causing a chaotic spill of guns.
memories.memory_text: I watched an alien grab a soldier who was running for the weapons cabinet and slam him into it so hard that guns went flying everywhere.

grounded_facts: Elgyn refuses to let DiStephano take custody of Wren, asserting that Wren remains under his control until they escape.
memories.memory_text: I inferred that Elgyn wasn't going to let DiStephano take Wren, because he insisted he'd only hand him over once we'd escaped.

grounded_facts: Wren informs Elgyn that the direct path is blocked due to the hull breach and suggests an alternate route through the holding cells.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed Wren tell Elgyn that the direct path was blocked due to the hull breach and suggest we go through the holding cells instead.

grounded_facts: The crew attempts to proceed but finds a door sealed due to the hull breach; they redirect through the holding cells.
memories.memory_text: I saw the sector doors slam shut when we tried to move forward, and Wren shouted that the hull had been breached, so we couldn't go through—he told us we'd have to take another route through the holding cells, and that's the way we went, dragging him along with guns still on me.

grounded_facts: Elgyn is killed by the Alien when it drops from the rafters and impales his skull with its tongue.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Elgyn is killed by the Alien when it drops from the rafters and impales his skull with its tongue.

grounded_facts: Ripley fights and kills the Alien in a brutal physical confrontation, ripping out its tongue.
memories.memory_text: I watched in horror as Ripley fought the Alien, grappling with it bare-handed, and finally ripped its tongue out after it lunged at her and she smashed it with a table.

grounded_facts: Ripley hands Call the severed Alien tongue as a disturbing souvenir, possibly in retaliation for being shot.
memories.memory_text: I tensed when Ripley walked up to me after the fight, and then she took my hand and put the severed Alien tongue in it—her way of making a point after I shot her.

grounded_facts: Wren discloses that there are thirty Aliens aboard the ship.
memories.memory_text: I heard Wren say there were thirty Aliens aboard the ship when Christie questioned him.

grounded_facts: Call reveals to the group that Ripley is a clone created by Wren and may carry an Alien inside her.
memories.memory_text: I told the group that Ripley wasn't human—that Wren cloned her because she was carrying an Alien inside her, and she could turn on us at any moment.

grounded_facts: Christie silences Call's objections about trusting Ripley by asserting his leadership.
memories.memory_text: I objected to trusting Ripley, but Christie silenced me by asserting his authority over the group.

grounded_facts: Hillard gently places her coat over Elgyn's face as a sign of mourning.
memories.memory_text: I saw Hillard gently place her coat over Elgyn's face as a way to mourn him.

grounded_facts: Hillard moves away when Call tries to comfort her after Elgyn's death.
memories.memory_text: I tried to comfort Hillard by putting my hand on her shoulder, but she moved away from me.

grounded_facts: Ripley gives Call a cold, unsettling smile, signaling lingering hostility.
memories.memory_text: I saw Ripley smile at me coldly, and it sent a chill through me—her expression was unsettling, full of lingering hostility.

grounded_facts: Vriess appears unexpectedly from a dark elevator, alive and armed, rejoining the surviving crew.
memories.memory_text: I saw sparks fly from the elevator and then Vriess appeared in the light, alive and armed, making everyone jolt and nearly fire before realizing it was him.

grounded_facts: Johner reveals to Vriess and the group that Call is a spy, escalating tension.
memories.memory_text: I learned from Johner that he had revealed to the others I was a spy, which escalated the tension around me.

grounded_facts: The group uses a holographic console to assess ship damage and plan a route to the Betty.
memories.memory_text: I was there when we used the holographic console to check the ship's damage and plan our route to the Betty—I saw the hologram show the broken sections and the path we'd need to take.

grounded_facts: Ripley reveals that the Aliens will breed rapidly, doubling in number within hours.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Ripley that the Aliens would breed rapidly and double in number within hours.

grounded_facts: Vriess distributes hidden weapons, giving a shotgun to Hillard and a grenade launcher to Call.
memories.memory_text: I saw Vriess unload weapons from his chair and toss a shotgun to Hillard, then pull out a grenade launcher and throw it to me.

grounded_facts: Vriess tosses a grenade launcher to Call without warmth, arming her for the journey.
memories.memory_text: Vriess called my name and tossed me the grenade launcher without any warmth, and I caught it just before he told me not to shoot my foot off.

grounded_facts: The group regroups after surviving the Alien attack to assess threats, reveal information, and debate trust.
memories.memory_text: I remember that The group regroups after surviving the Alien attack to assess threats, reveal information, and debate trust.

grounded_facts: The group gathers at the guards' station to use the ship's console to plan their route to the Betty.
memories.memory_text: I remember that The group gathers at the guards' station to use the ship's console to plan their route to the Betty.

grounded_facts: Ripley senses the ship is moving, prompting Call to verify via the computer.
memories.memory_text: I felt Ripley's urgency when she said the ship was moving, and I checked the computer to confirm it myself.

grounded_facts: The ship has automatically started moving toward Earth due to damage, a fact revealed by Call and confirmed by Wren.
memories.memory_text: I told the others the ship had been moving since the attack, and Wren confirmed it was on autopilot to Earth due to the damage.

grounded_facts: Call angrily questions Wren for withholding knowledge that the ship would autopilot to Earth.
memories.memory_text: I confronted Wren, asking if he ever planned to tell us the ship was heading to Earth, after he admitted he forgot.

grounded_facts: Johner asks Ripley about her prior experience with the Aliens.
memories.memory_text: I heard Johner ask Ripley if she'd faced the Aliens before, and she told him, 'I died.'

grounded_facts: The group moves through a destroyed lab, encountering signs of recent Alien violence.
memories.memory_text: I remember that The group moves through a destroyed lab, encountering signs of recent Alien violence.

grounded_facts: The group enters a trashed lab and finds three bodies with exploded chests, indicating prior Alien presence and violence.
memories.memory_text: I saw the lab was trashed when we moved through it, and I noticed three bodies with their chests exploded outward.

grounded_facts: Christie asks Ripley to lead the group during their movement.
memories.memory_text: I saw Christie ask Ripley to take point as we moved through the chambers, and then they went in with Ripley following right after.

grounded_facts: The group finalizes their escape plan, confirms weapon readiness, and learns the ship is moving toward Earth.
memories.memory_text: I remember that The group finalizes their escape plan, confirms weapon readiness, and learns the ship is moving toward Earth.

grounded_facts: The group encounters Purvis, who attacks them with a metal bar out of fear, leading to a tense standoff before he is subdued and questioned.
memories.memory_text: I saw Purvis leap out of the shadows and attack Ripley with a metal bar, swinging it wildly as we rushed in — he was terrified, and I told him to come with us because it was too dangerous to stay there.

grounded_facts: Ripley detects that Purvis is carrying an alien organism inside his body, revealing a critical threat to the group.
memories.memory_text: I heard Ripley say she could smell something inside Purvis — that he had an alien organism in him, and it was a critical threat to all of us.

grounded_facts: Ripley bluntly informs Purvis that he has an alien creature inside him that will kill him by bursting from his chest.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Ripley that there's a monster inside Purvis that will burst from his chest and kill him in a few hours — she said it plainly, and I believed her.

grounded_facts: The group decides to take the infected Purvis with them instead of killing or abandoning him, altering their risk profile and mission constraints.
memories.memory_text: I saw the others hesitate, but I knew we had to take Purvis with us instead of leaving him behind or killing him, even though it meant risking the rest of us.

grounded_facts: Call asserts command over the group's decision to save Purvis, provoking Johner's resentment and verbal confrontation.
memories.memory_text: I told the group that Purvis comes with us — we can freeze him on the Betty and get the doctor to remove the alien later, and when Johner challenged me, I told him it’s been this way since he was born without balls.

grounded_facts: Christie warns Purvis that he will be shot if he becomes aggressive, establishing controlled escort terms.
memories.memory_text: I heard Christie warn Purvis that he’d be shot if he got aggressive, making it clear we were taking him under controlled escort.

grounded_facts: Ripley proposes throwing Call into the alien chamber as bait to lure the creatures into the trap.
memories.memory_text: I remember Ripley suggesting we throw someone in to lure the aliens, and then she grabbed me—I felt like I was being offered as bait.

grounded_facts: The group encounters active alien threats and devises a trap using liquid nitrogen to eliminate them.
Wren uses the liquid nitrogen failsafe to freeze three aliens after luring them into the chamber.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed the group's plan to lure the aliens into the chamber, and I saw Wren activate the liquid nitrogen to freeze them.

grounded_facts: Call tells Ripley she is more human than she thought, implying Ripley's willingness to sacrifice others makes her cruelly human.
memories.memory_text: I told Ripley she was more human than I thought, after seeing how she reacted to the clones.

grounded_facts: Call hands the grenade launcher to Ripley, enabling her to destroy the clones.
memories.memory_text: I handed the grenade launcher to Ripley so she could destroy the clones.

grounded_facts: Ripley enters the Cloning Storage Facility and destroys the failed Ripley clones with a grenade launcher.
memories.memory_text: I saw Ripley use the grenade launcher to destroy the failed clones in the facility.

grounded_facts: Ripley discovers and destroys the failed clones of herself in the Cloning Storage Facility.
memories.memory_text: I saw Ripley discover the failed clones of herself and then destroy them with grenades I gave her.

grounded_facts: After Ripley spares Wren, Call punches him in the jaw as a warning.
memories.memory_text: After Ripley spared Wren, I punched him in the jaw as a warning.

grounded_facts: The group discovers that the cooling tanks have been breached, flooding the corridor with water.
memories.memory_text: I saw the corridor was flooded with water, and Vriess said the cooling tanks must have blown during the trouble, so I realized we’d have to swim through it to escape.

grounded_facts: The crew navigates a flooded corridor and kitchen under threat, culminating in an alien ambush and surface-level facehugger attack.
memories.memory_text: I was with the crew when we swam through the flooded corridor and kitchen, and I got caught in the alien webbing underwater, struggling to breathe.

grounded_facts: The crew swims through a flooded corridor and kitchen, only to be ambushed by three aliens in the water, initiating combat and triggering a desperate escape.
memories.memory_text: I swam through the flooded corridor and kitchen with the crew, and just as we were making our way through, we were ambushed by three aliens in the water who attacked us, forcing us into a desperate fight to escape.

grounded_facts: The group observes two aliens killing a group of soldiers, confirming the presence and threat of multiple aliens.
memories.memory_text: I saw two aliens attack and kill the soldiers, and I realized how dangerous they were.

grounded_facts: Di Stephano inhales water and stops breathing during underwater passage; later revives after being pulled out and receiving aid.
memories.memory_text: I saw Di Stephano inhale water and stop breathing during the underwater passage; I helped give him mouth-to-mouth after Johner and Hillard pulled him out, and I was there when he sputtered back to life.

grounded_facts: Wren, unable to open a jammed maintenance door, shoots Call through the chest to use her gun as a tool, killing her and sealing himself inside.
Wren uses Call's gun to force open a jammed door, but instead of returning it, he shoots her through the chest, killing her.
memories.memory_text: I handed my gun to Wren to help open the jammed door, but instead of using it as a tool, he shot me through the chest without hesitation, killing me.

grounded_facts: As survivors break the surface, facehuggers ambush them, attempting to attach to Ripley, Wren, and others; eggs are destroyed in response.
memories.memory_text: When we broke the surface, facehuggers attacked us, trying to latch onto Ripley, Wren, and the others; I saw one clamp onto Ripley and others targeting the crew, and I watched as they destroyed the eggs in response.

grounded_facts: An alien grabs Christie during climb; he fires twice, killing it despite being injured by acid blood.
An alien attacks Christie during climb; he is sprayed with acid blood and loses grip, but survives after Vriess supports him and he kills the alien.
memories.memory_text: I saw an alien grab Christie during the climb; he was sprayed with acid blood and lost his grip, but Vriess supported him and he managed to fire twice, killing the creature.

grounded_facts: The final alien disengages and retreats downward after Christie is attacked, ending immediate threat.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed the final alien suddenly disengage and scurry back down the shaft after its brothers, ending the immediate threat to the others.

grounded_facts: Hillard cuts the cord binding Christie's body to Vriess to allow continued escape.
memories.memory_text: I saw Hillard cut the cord that was binding Christie's body to Vriess so we could keep moving.

grounded_facts: Christie's body, carried by Vriess, is confirmed dead; Hillard cuts the cord binding him to Vriess, allowing the body to fall into the shaft.
memories.memory_text: I watched Christie's body fall into the dark shaft after the cord was cut, and there was silence as it dropped.

grounded_facts: After Christie's body falls, two aliens are spotted ascending the shaft, prompting renewed urgency in the climb.
memories.memory_text: I heard a loud clacking from below and saw the aliens climbing fast after Christie's body fell, so we had to hurry up the shaft.

grounded_facts: Survivors climb a vertical liftshaft under alien pursuit, facing betrayal, falls, injuries, and eventual retreat of enemies.
memories.memory_text: I climbed the liftshaft with the others while the aliens pursued us, and I helped operate the lift even after being attacked.

grounded_facts: Ripley fires at the lift's support cables, causing it to plummet and crush two aliens at the bottom of the shaft.
memories.memory_text: I saw Ripley take Hillard's shotgun and fire at the lift's cables, making it plummet and crush the two aliens at the bottom.

grounded_facts: After being pulled from the lift, Call's chest wound reveals synthetic wiring instead of blood and bone, exposing her as an artificial being.
memories.memory_text: I remember Ripley pulling me from the lift, and then the wound in my chest gaped open—no blood, no bone, just a tangle of synthorganic wiring. I knew in that moment my body had betrayed me, revealing what I truly was.

grounded_facts: Johner ridicules Call after learning she is a synthetic, making crude jokes about her mechanical nature.
memories.memory_text: I heard Johner laugh and say something about needing an oil change, and I realized he was mocking me—telling Vriess to get a socket wrench, as if I were just a machine to be serviced.

grounded_facts: Call reveals she burned her modem drive to prevent remote access to the ship's systems, a self-sabotage to resist forced use.
memories.memory_text: I told the others I can't connect remotely because I burned my modem drive to stop anyone from taking control.

grounded_facts: Ripley pressures Call to plug into the mainframe despite her resistance, using moral leverage about Earth's safety.
memories.memory_text: I resisted when Ripley pressured me to plug in, telling her I didn't want to go in there because it feels like my insides turn to liquid, but she pushed me by reminding me I could blow the ship before it reaches Earth, and that convinced me.

grounded_facts: Ripley and Call enter the chapel to use its computer ports so Call can manually access the ship's mainframe and potentially trigger self-destruct.
memories.memory_text: I went into the chapel with Ripley so I could plug into the ship's mainframe using the port in my arm.

grounded_facts: Call reveals her forearm ports and connects a cable to access the ship's computer system manually.
memories.memory_text: I pulled up my sleeve, opened the panel on my forearm, and plugged the cable into my port so I could access the ship's system directly.

grounded_facts: After learning Wren is approaching the ship, Ripley asks Call, 'And how do you feel about that?'
memories.memory_text: After I connected, Ripley asked me how I felt about Wren approaching the ship, putting me on the spot while I was still interfacing with the system.

grounded_facts: Call uses the ship's PA system to announce 'Father's dead, asshole' to Wren, shocking and disorienting him.
Call connects to the ship's PA system and takes control from the AI 'Father', speaking through the ship's speakers to confront Wren.
memories.memory_text: I took control of the PA system from Father and told Wren, 'Father's dead, asshole,' then broadcast that there was an intruder on level one and directed all aliens to proceed there.

grounded_facts: Call uses the ship's system to redirect aliens toward Wren's location, marking him as an intruder.
Call broadcasts 'Intruder on level one... all aliens please proceed to level one' through the ship's system, directing threats toward Wren.
memories.memory_text: I used the ship's system to mark Wren as an intruder and reroute the aliens toward his location, making sure the threat moved to where he was.

grounded_facts: When Ripley offers to examine her chest wiring, Call snaps 'Don't touch me,' rejecting physical contact.
memories.memory_text: I snapped at Ripley to not touch me when she reached for my chest wiring.

grounded_facts: Call confronts her synthetic nature, calling herself 'disgusting' and questioning her existence, showing emotional deterioration.
memories.memory_text: I looked at the hole in my chest and saw the white, sticky fibers inside, and I said out loud, 'I'm disgusting,' because I couldn't stand what I am.

grounded_facts: Ripley reveals that her nightmares about the aliens are less horrifying than reality, indicating psychological endurance.
memories.memory_text: I heard Ripley say that her nightmares about the aliens were better than reality, and it made me realize how much she's endured.

grounded_facts: Call removes the cable from her forearm port, ending her direct connection to the ship's computer system.
memories.memory_text: After finishing my work in the system, I disconnected the cable from my forearm port, adjusted my internal wiring, and said it was time to get going.

grounded_facts: Ripley hesitates at the controls; Call turns on the ignition to help her start driving.
memories.memory_text: I saw Ripley hesitating at the controls, so I reached over and turned on the ignition to help her get the jeep started.

grounded_facts: Hillard is killed by an alien that bores into her head during the ambush.
memories.memory_text: I watched in horror as an alien shot out of the brush and bored into Hillard's head before St Just could stop it, and then her body fell away from the jeep.

grounded_facts: The vehicle goes off-road and crashes down multiple terraced drops to escape pursuing aliens.
memories.memory_text: I was in the jeep when we went off-road, crashing down one terraced slope after another to get away from the aliens; I remember us barely hanging on as the vehicle sailed over each ledge and rocked violently all the way down.

grounded_facts: Multiple aliens launch a sudden attack on the vehicle as it traverses the garden, initiating a chase.
memories.memory_text: I saw multiple aliens suddenly attacking the vehicle as we drove through the garden, leaping out and forcing Ripley to swerve and speed up to get away.

grounded_facts: The vehicle reaches the end of the garden where three paths diverge, requiring a directional decision.
Ripley asks which way to go when reaching a junction in the garden paths.
memories.memory_text: I was in the vehicle when we reached the end of the garden and saw the three paths splitting off—I remember Ripley asking which way we should go while we were still under attack.

grounded_facts: The crew uses a platform jeep to cross the large garden area, transitioning from one end to the other under increasing threat.
memories.memory_text: I was in the jeep with the crew as we raced across the garden, trying to get from one end to the other while under attack.

grounded_facts: The crew discovers a large, unexpected growth of cannabis plants while crossing the garden in a vehicle.
memories.memory_text: I saw the vast field of cannabis plants suddenly appear as we drove through the garden, and I couldn't believe what I was seeing.

grounded_facts: The ship detects potential hull breach and issues a warning to clear the sector.
The ship reiterates a warning to evacuate the sector.
memories.memory_text: I heard the ship warn of a potential hull breach and tell us to clear the sector, then repeat the order to evacuate.

grounded_facts: The crew flees the garden sector under alien attack, reaching a door to escape.
memories.memory_text: I was running with the crew, desperate to get out of the garden sector while the ship's warnings blared in my ears.

grounded_facts: St Just provides covering fire to protect the crew during their escape.
memories.memory_text: I saw St Just firing relentlessly, mowing down aliens even as more kept coming, buying us time to reach the door.

grounded_facts: A coordinated alien assault in the hall results in decompression and crew casualties.
memories.memory_text: I felt the blast as the hall burst open, the decompression nearly pulling me out, and I saw someone get slammed against the closing door.

grounded_facts: Call helps Ripley up after she is injured by the door impact.
memories.memory_text: I stopped and ran back to help Ripley up after she was dazed from the impact with the door.

grounded_facts: Ripley begins hearing psychic signals from the alien hive, sensing the queen's pain.
memories.memory_text: I inferred that Ripley was beginning to sense the hive psychically because she spoke about hearing the queen and sensing her pain, though I wasn't sure how it was possible.

grounded_facts: Ripley reports hearing the alien hive and sensing the queen's pain.
memories.memory_text: I heard Ripley tell me she could hear the aliens in the hive and that the queen was in pain.

grounded_facts: Ripley throws Call out of harm's way as aliens emerge from the floor.
memories.memory_text: I barely had time to react when Ripley grabbed me and threw me down the corridor to keep me safe from the aliens.

grounded_facts: Ripley is slammed against the closing door during decompression, suffering a head injury.
memories.memory_text: I saw Ripley get sucked backward by the decompression and slam into the closing door, hitting her head hard.

grounded_facts: Ripley is overwhelmed and dragged into the floor panels by aliens after pushing Call to safety.
memories.memory_text: I saw the aliens overwhelm Ripley after she pushed me to safety, and I watched as they dragged her unconscious body under the floor.

grounded_facts: Aliens breach the floor and seize Ripley during a corridor confrontation.
memories.memory_text: I saw the aliens burst up through the floor and surround Ripley before dragging her down under the panels.

grounded_facts: Ripley is carried unconscious through air vents by aliens, regaining partial awareness.
memories.memory_text: I saw the aliens grab Ripley and carry her through the vents; she was barely conscious, her eyes fluttering open as they moved her.

grounded_facts: After witnessing the Queen's suffering and learning the truth, Ripley vows to escape the chamber.
memories.memory_text: I inferred that after seeing the Queen suffer and learning the truth, Ripley must have decided she had to get out of that chamber.

grounded_facts: The crew arrives at the loading dock and prepares to board the Betty for immediate departure.
memories.memory_text: I saw the crew arrive at the loading dock and rush toward the Betty, and I knew I had to help get us all onboard quickly.

grounded_facts: Purvis convinces Call that leaving Ripley behind is the best mercy, pressuring her to move on.
memories.memory_text: I was convinced by Purvis that leaving Ripley behind was the best way to show her mercy, and I accepted it was time to move on.

grounded_facts: The crew's organized movement to the loading dock and boarding of the Betty under time pressure.
memories.memory_text: I rushed with the crew to the Betty under time pressure, and when Vriess said he needed me to patch in and open the hatch, I acknowledged it and ran onboard with them.

grounded_facts: DiStephano refuses Wren's order to disarm the others and instead aims at Wren.
memories.memory_text: I saw DiStephano refuse Wren's order and aim his weapon at him, even with the gun still pressed to my back.

grounded_facts: The Alien Queen gives birth to a unique white newborn, initiating a massacre in the waste tank.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed the Alien Queen's belly burst open and blood spray everywhere, and then everything went silent — all movement and screaming stopped at once.

grounded_facts: Wren holds a gun to Call's back and threatens to kill her if others resist.
Wren emerges and holds a gun to Call's back, threatening to kill her if others resist.
Wren takes Call hostage and demands control of the ship, leading to a tense confrontation.
memories.memory_text: I felt Wren grab me and press a gun to my back, and I heard him threaten to kill me if anyone resisted — I knew he was serious when he demanded I plug the ship back in to land it.

grounded_facts: Call directly opposes Wren's intention to bring the aliens to Earth.
memories.memory_text: I told Wren 'No she's not' to stop him from taking the aliens to Earth, because I knew it was too dangerous.

grounded_facts: Johner ridicules Wren's belief that he can control the aliens.
memories.memory_text: I heard Johner mock Wren, asking if he had been paying attention, like anyone could control those creatures.

grounded_facts: Purvis launches himself at Wren, initiating a violent struggle.
memories.memory_text: I saw Purvis launch himself at Wren, screaming, and the fight broke out right in front of me.

grounded_facts: An alien bursts from Purvis's chest into Wren's skull, killing both.
memories.memory_text: I watched the alien burst from Purvis's chest and shoot straight into Wren's skull, killing them both.

grounded_facts: Ripley tears free from her restraints after the newborn attacks a soldier.
memories.memory_text: I tore myself free from the restraints when the newborn lunged at me, screaming as I plunged into the pool below.

grounded_facts: Ripley retrieves a fallen soldier's rifle from the pool.
memories.memory_text: I remember pulling myself out of the pool, covered in blood, and grabbing the fallen soldier's rifle—I must have seen it just in time to start firing.

grounded_facts: Ripley shoots holes in the tank wall and smashes through to escape.
memories.memory_text: I shot at the tank wall until light streamed through the holes, then I smashed through to escape.

grounded_facts: Call warns Johner not to shoot due to the ship's thin hull, but Johner ignores her and continues firing.
memories.memory_text: I warned Johner not to shoot because Betty's hull is too thin, but he ignored me and kept firing anyway.

grounded_facts: A newborn alien attacks the crew aboard the Betty, leading to chaotic evasion and combat.
memories.memory_text: I saw the newborn alien attack the crew aboard the Betty, and I witnessed Johner shooting at it as it lunged toward Vriess.

grounded_facts: Call defends herself against a leaping newborn alien by deploying a hidden blade that impales and kills it.
memories.memory_text: I defended myself when the newborn alien leaped at me—I stumbled back, flicked my wrist, and my hidden blade shot out, impaling the creature through the mouth and killing it as it wriggled and fell away.

grounded_facts: Johner commands Vriess to take control of the ship during the alien attack.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed Johner shout at Vriess to get behind the wheel during the alien attack.

grounded_facts: Ripley quickly climbs up a vertical air shaft to evade pursuing aliens, using a pipe to break a steam line that slows the aliens down.
Ripley rips out a superheated pole, causing a burst of steam that impedes the aliens chasing her in the vent shaft.
memories.memory_text: I saw Ripley climb up the vertical shaft and rip a superheated pole from the wall, releasing a burst of steam that slowed the aliens behind her.

grounded_facts: The Betty is descending rapidly with braking system failure, warning of imminent collision, while crew attempts to correct descent.
memories.memory_text: I was monitoring the descent and said we were almost there, but then I heard the ship warn that the braking system was nonfunctional, we weren't leveling for the drop, and a collision was imminent.

grounded_facts: The Auriga collides with Earth's surface, resulting in a massive explosion that destroys the ship.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Auriga heading straight for Earth and then it smashed into the ground, exploding in a deafening blast that consumed the entire ship.

grounded_facts: An instrument panel sparks and warning lights flash, indicating a fire onboard The Betty.
memories.memory_text: I saw the instrument panel spark beside me, and warning lights started flashing as the ship shook violently, so I knew we had a fire onboard The Betty.

grounded_facts: Johner identifies Ripley on the hatch via monitor and reports her presence to the crew.
memories.memory_text: I heard Johner shout that Ripley was on the hatch, and in that moment I knew I had to act to get her inside.

grounded_facts: Johner refuses Call's order to open the hatch, citing the presence of a dangerous creature with Ripley.
memories.memory_text: I ordered the hatch opened to let Ripley in, but Johner refused, shouting that there was something else out there with her and insisting, 'No. it's something else.'

grounded_facts: The crew of The Betty attempts to stabilize the ship after evading the Auriga, dealing with fire, turbulence, and external threats.
memories.memory_text: I was fighting to control The Betty after we evaded the Auriga, dealing with fire, turbulence, and system failures, and I had to push Johner aside to reach the hatch release and help Ripley.

grounded_facts: Ripley reaches the open hatch and is dragged inside by Call just before the alien slams into the closing door.
memories.memory_text: I saw Ripley at the hatch and pulled her inside just before the alien slammed into the door as I closed it.

grounded_facts: Call opens the hatch of The Betty to engage the alien with a grenade launcher, creating an opportunity for Ripley to enter.
Call uses a grenade launcher to attack the newborn alien, driving it back temporarily.
memories.memory_text: I opened the hatch of The Betty and fired my grenade launcher at the newborn alien to drive it back, creating a chance for Ripley to get inside.

grounded_facts: The crew attempts to land the damaged Betty in rough terrain after being pursued by the Newborn.
memories.memory_text: I headed into the cockpit with Ripley to try to land the Betty after the braking systems were shot, and I told her to find me a patch of land because I'd put her down, even though we were being pursued.

grounded_facts: Call activates the thrusters to incinerate the Newborn, which retreats temporarily.
memories.memory_text: I activated the thrusters to rocket the ship forward and incinerate the Newborn, which let go and retreated for a moment.

grounded_facts: The Betty makes a forced landing in a forested area after sustaining damage, skidding through trees and coming to a halt.
memories.memory_text: I felt the ship blast through trees as I tried to control the descent, and we mowed down a half acre of forest before finally grinding to a halt.

grounded_facts: Call prepares to exit the ship to hunt down the Newborn after the crash.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Call prepares to exit the ship to hunt down the Newborn after the crash.

grounded_facts: Ripley intercepts Call and assumes responsibility for hunting the Newborn.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Ripley intercepts Call and assumes responsibility for hunting the Newborn.

grounded_facts: Call hands over the grenade launcher to Ripley, acknowledging her superior ability to catch the Newborn.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Call hands over the grenade launcher to Ripley, acknowledging her superior ability to catch the Newborn.

grounded_facts: After the crash, the crew confronts the surviving Newborn, leading to Call and Ripley preparing to pursue it.
memories.memory_text: After the crash, I opened the hatch and the Newborn lunged at me with its tongue, but I dropped to the floor and Ripley dragged me out of the way; I grabbed a grenade launcher and tossed it to her as we prepared to go after it.

grounded_facts: Call arrives in the Harvester and repeatedly rams the Newborn to protect Ripley.
memories.memory_text: I flew the Harvester straight at the Newborn, ramming it again and again to keep it off Ripley, even when it flipped the machine and I was left hanging, barely conscious.

grounded_facts: While tracking the Newborn, Ripley reaches a cliff and sees a large city on the horizon.
memories.memory_text: I was trapped under the harvester, struggling to reach the lever while the newborn loomed over me, and in that moment of terror, I saw Ripley reach the cliff and spot a city on the horizon.

grounded_facts: Ripley calls out and runs to draw the Newborn's attention away from Call, who is trying to activate the Harvester.
memories.memory_text: I saw Ripley run and shout to draw the Newborn's attention away from me while I struggled to activate the Harvester, and I knew she was giving me the chance I needed.

grounded_facts: After her grenade launcher runs out of ammo, Ripley attacks the Newborn directly to push it onto the Harvester.
memories.memory_text: I saw Ripley empty her grenade launcher into the Newborn and then throw herself at it, slamming it onto the Harvester even as it tried to crush her.

grounded_facts: Ripley and Call engage the Newborn in a final battle using the Harvester, resulting in its destruction.
memories.memory_text: I piloted the Harvester and rammed the Newborn multiple times until it flipped over with me trapped underneath, and when I saw its blood seeping all around me, I thought I was going to die, but Ripley pulled me free and held me as we watched the creature get destroyed.

grounded_facts: Call activates the harvester's blades, which consume and destroy the Newborn.
memories.memory_text: I pulled the lever to activate the blades, feeling the machine roar to life and tear into the Newborn, and I remember lying on the ground afterward, trapped and burning, until Ripley dragged me out and held me as we watched it die.

grounded_facts: After the Newborn is destroyed, Ripley saves Call from being trapped under the burning Harvester.
memories.memory_text: I was trapped under the burning Harvester, unable to move, and I felt Ripley wriggle underneath and wrench me free before pulling me out; then I lay on the ground with her arms around me, both of us covered in blood, breathing hard and holding each other as we watched the alien burn.

grounded_facts: A post-conflict moment where the survivors gather around a camp-fire to reflect, bond, and consider their next steps on Earth.
The four characters sit together by a large camp-fire, observing the burning wreckage and sharing a moment of respite.
memories.memory_text: I sat by the large camp-fire with the others, watching the burning wreckage and taking a moment to breathe after everything we'd been through.

grounded_facts: Vriess tosses a bottle of whiskey to Christie, initiating a casual but bonding gesture.
memories.memory_text: I saw Vriess toss a bottle of whiskey to Christie, starting that quiet, shared moment between us.

grounded_facts: Christie passes the whiskey bottle to Call, including her in the group ritual.
memories.memory_text: Christie passed the whiskey to me, and I took it, feeling included in the circle before I drank and passed it on.

grounded_facts: Call hands the whiskey bottle to Ripley, initiating a symbolic gesture of camaraderie and inclusion.
Call hands the whiskey to Ripley and engages her in conversation, signaling unity.
memories.memory_text: I handed the whiskey bottle to Ripley and told her, 'It's a drink. You drink it,' to include her in the moment and show we're in this together.

grounded_facts: Call turns to Ripley to ask what they should do next, deferring to her experience.
memories.memory_text: I turned to Ripley and asked her what we should do next, because I hoped she might know based on her experience.

grounded_facts: Ripley and Call discuss what to do next, acknowledging their uncertainty and outsider status on Earth.
memories.memory_text: I remember talking with Ripley about our uncertain future, and how she said she didn't know what to do either, admitting she felt like a stranger on Earth just like me.

grounded_facts: Ripley rises and moves to the cliff edge, then remains with Call in a shared stance, indicating a choice to remain in the group rather than isolate herself.
memories.memory_text: I got up and went over to Ripley at the cliff edge, standing beside her as we both looked out at the horizon together.
